summary_1line: Gandhari warns Dhritarashtra that Duryodhana will destroy their race, but he fatalistically allows another dice game with the Pandavas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Blind king Dhritarashtra sits on his throne while the blindfolded Gandhari stands before him pleading passionately to stop the ruin of their race.
Gandhari, veiled and anguished, raises her hands in warning as courtiers watch silently in the dim royal hall.
